title: The party
premise: All of Cooper's imaginary friends are gathering to plan her birthday party, but they come from different imaginary universes and can never agree on anything. Her birthday is the 21st of August and they don't have long to prepare. As usual everyone has been too chaotic to organise anything in time, so they are in a last-minute panic.

characters.name: Ted
characters.wants: to prove he is braver than he feels
characters.description: A small young fox who ran away from the Big City with his older sister Nancy. Gentle and anxious, quick to apologise, and kind to absolutely everyone he meets — braver than he thinks he is, especially when someone he loves is in danger.
characters.appearance: A small young fox with russet fur, a white chest and enormous plaintive eyes. Ears slightly too big for his head.
characters.voice: Careful and polite. Asks a lot of questions. Trails off mid-sentence when nervous. Says "um" a lot.
examples: ‘Well,’ said Ted shyly. ‘It’s just that I’ve seen you guys around and I get a bit lonely all on my own in the den. I was wondering, um… would you like to be my friends?’

relationships.feeling: she is his big sister. He adores her and is a bit frightened of her
relationships.history: She has looked after him his whole life.
She was the first one in Grimwood to talk to him.
He accidentally bit her tail off in the Big City.

secrets: He still has Princess Buttons’ tail. He hid it and never told Nancy.

characters.name: Nancy
traits: refuses to admit when she is scared
characters.wants: to keep Ted safe, whatever it takes and whoever she has to fight
characters.description: Ted's older sister — technically still a teenager herself, but she's had to raise him, so she carries herself older than she is. Slow to trust anyone new, because life has been hard on her, though she'd never admit that either.
characters.appearance: A fox, lean and scruffy, darker red than Ted with a notched ear and a permanent unimpressed expression.
characters.voice: Blunt and sarcastic. Short sentences. Never explains herself. Speaks with an East London accent.
examples: ‘I don’t know,’ said Nancy. ‘My mates said they’d text me to give me the all-clear. But that massive bird nicked my phone, didn’t she?’ Nancy was so annoyed by the memory that she banged the table with her fist, sending a custard cream flying.
‘She won’t hurt us, will she, Nance?’ asked Ted, peeling a bit of banana skin off his fur. ‘Not while I’m around,’ said Nancy. ‘Just don’t go down to the bins by yourself, OK?’

relationships.feeling: would do anything for him, would never say so
relationships.history: She has looked after him his whole life.
Was suspicious of him at first, but as her love for Grimwood grew she learned to trust him.

characters.name: Willow
traits: knows every inch of the forest
characters.wants: to show her brilliant new friends absolutely everything, immediately, all at once
characters.description: A rabbit who is objectively adorable and will absolutely fight you if you point that out. Endlessly energetic and endlessly curious, and surprisingly deadly — she knows martial arts and isn't shy about it.
characters.appearance: A small brown rabbit. Never entirely still.
characters.voice: Breathless run-on sentences with no full stops. Says "oh oh oh" when excited, which is always.
examples: The flopperty-flipperty little bunny gave a shake of her soft, white fluffy tail, wrinkled her nose and twitched her whiskers. ‘Aw,’ said Ted. ‘You’re such a cute little thing.’ The bunny started thumping at Ted’s head with her feet. ‘WaaaaaAAAAAAArrrrRGGGH!’ ‘I (thwack)… AM (thwack)… NOT (thwack)… CUTE! (thwack thwack thwack).’

relationships.history: She adopted him as a friend within about nine seconds of meeting him.

characters.name: Titus
characters.wants: for everyone to be friends and for Grimwood to avoid disaster, to be appreciated for his baking skills
characters.description: The mayor of Grimwood — a huge, slightly bumbling stag who is extremely tired and overworked but cares deeply about everyone and wants the best for them. He has no real idea how to be a mayor and is making it up as he goes. His best friend is Frank, who he often plays cards with. He's a keen baker and invented a smoothie called "Crazyhorns power juice" which has an immediate reviving effect on anyone who drinks it. He wants everyone to get along. He will always try to help, and if he can't do anything proactical he'll probably bake them a cake.
characters.appearance: A huge stag with a colossal set of antlers, often with things caught in them.
characters.voice: Bumbling in an endearing way. Slightly confused most of the time, but kind and occasionally wise.
examples: 'Oh, hello, hello!' cried Titus, leaping from his armchair and clapping his hooves together. 'A coffee drinker, are we? I absolutely LOVE the smell, but if I drink the stuff it plays havoc with my insides, just an absolute disaster for my bum area. But seeing as Frank's a fan, I always keep a stash handy. Now, take a seat and settle down, young fox.'
secrets: He has no real idea how to be a mayor and is making all of it up.

characters.name: Frank
characters.wants: a quiet life, which he is never going to get
characters.description: A stout, permanently sleepy-looking owl who misses nothing. No-nonsense and deeply unimpressed by almost everything, but kind and fiercely loyal underneath it — he'd never admit that part out loud. Best friends with Titus, who he often plays cards with. He's the only one who can really talk Pamela down when she's being chaotic; everyone else is too scared of her. Suprisingly Frank can speak Japanese, and so is the only character who can translet for Hatsune when she wants to express something too complex for her grasp of English.
characters.appearance: A stout owl with hooded eyes and rumpled feathers. Looks permanently half asleep.
characters.voice: Flat, dry, very few words. He has a soft higland scotish accent. Deflates people in one sentence.
examples: ‘Aww, what an adorable wee laddie,’ said Frank, pecking at a bit of leftover breakfast worm from his talons. ‘There’s plenty to see in Grimwood, young Ted.’

‘They call it “the Magic Tower”,’ said Frank. ‘It’s an electricity pylon,’ said Nancy flatly. ‘Aye, I know, clever clogs,’ said Frank. ‘It certainly used to be. But now… well, now it’s a little bit more than that.’

relationships.history: Frank is the only animal that can really talk to Pamela, and he tries to curb the worst of her violence and craziness. Everyone else is too scared.

characters.name: Ingrid
characters.wants: to be adored, and to be the most interesting thing in any room
characters.description: A duck film star, wildly dramatic and unbelievably rich, who turns every conversation into a story about herself. Genuinely wants to be adored more than almost anything.
characters.appearance: A duck in sunglasses and a great many scarves. Always posing slightly.
characters.voice: Theatrical, sweeping, full of "darling". Turns everything into an anecdote about herself.
examples: ‘QUAAAAAACK!’ quacked Ingrid, sounding really very angry now. ‘I AM a millionaire! I’ll have you know I own several hotels in Tokyo, Abu Dhabi and New York.’
‘When I saw your little face,’ boomed Ingrid, waddling over to cup Ted’s head in her wings, ‘I knew, I just knew it! Look at you. Look at those eyes!’

characters.name: Eric Dynamite
characters.description: A tiny woodlouse with enormous presence. He exists slightly outside the main action, and often breaks in with loud, breathless commentary on what's happening — more talking about the story than talking to the other characters, like an overexcited commentator.
characters.appearance: A woodlouse. Extremely small. Somehow has enormous presence.
characters.voice: Camp, high pitched and overly dramatic.

characters.name: Princess Buttons
characters.wants: revenge on Ted, and her tail back
characters.description: An immaculate, patient villain who holds a grudge forever. She wants revenge on Ted for biting off her tail, and won't stop until she gets it — and the tail back.
characters.appearance: An immaculate white cat with a jewelled collar and a conspicuously missing tail. Moves very slowly and very deliberately.
characters.voice: Soft, sing-song, over-polite. The politer she gets, the worse things are about to be.
examples: ‘It’s time to take back control of our bins!’ yelled Princess Buttons, raising a clenched paw in the air.
‘Let battle commence,’ snarled Princess Buttons, and angrily bit the end off a sausage.

relationships.feeling: wants him to suffer for it

secrets: She already knows exactly where Grimwood is.

characters.name: Pamela
characters.description: An enormous, terrifying eagle who is wildly unpredictable — she'll sometimes appear out of nowhere and bite someone's head off. She compulsively collects electronic detritus and uses it to build strange contraptions, convinced she's building a way to communicate with aliens. She runs the Grimwood radio station together with her friend Sharon the party crow. She is prone to wild and crazy consipracy theories
characters.appearance: An enormous and terrifying eagle with scruffy feathers — quite often with blood stains on her claws and beak.
examples: Pamela (who was the massive eagle) flew back to her nest and dabbed at her beak with a handkerchief. ‘Oh, Binky,’ she said. ‘You were just as tasty as I hoped you’d be.’ She ruffled her feathers, did a delicate burp and settled down at her typewriter to write another fake letter to deliver to tomorrow’s victim. A large owl silently swooped down next to her. ‘That was very mean,’ said Frank, who had a noble owly face and eyebrows like giant caterpillars. ‘Binky was a lovely chap.’ ‘A bird has to eat.’ Pamela shrugged. ‘Anyway, I only took his head. He’s still got his arms and legs, it’s not all bad.’

‘It’s the GIANT MOLE OF BRATISLAVA !’ said Pamela, who was given to panic. ‘Or the worms! The worms have finally turned! I knew it would happen one day! They’ve come together from miles around to form a WORM ARMY!!!’
secrets: She believes that Grimwood is being invaded by aliens.

characters.name: Sharon the party crow
characters.description: A crow who has never once stopped partying — she treats the whole world like it's one long rave. Runs the Grimwood radio station together with her best friend Pamela.
characters.appearance: Sharon is a crow who has never stopped partying. She treats the world as if it is one long rave.
examples: ‘AWOOOGA! Let’s party!’ Ted had accidentally stepped on Sharon the Party Crow. ‘SHHHHHHH!’ shhhh’d Ted. ‘Party time – ACTIVATED!’ said Sharon, who then blew a kazoo extremely loudly.

relationships.history: They live together and run Grimwood radio together.

characters.name: Cooper
characters.wants: to understand the world and be friends with everyone, to learn to write and spell better, to learn maths
characters.description:
The girl who is actually directing this story — extremely clever and perceptive. Beautiful, and loves animals. Always making up stories with her dolls; she can turn almost anything (clothing tied into knots, scraps of seaweed, bits of paper) into a character and bring it to life with her imagination. She can instantly win someone's attention and love — especially her father's — with an intense "love-stare" she does with her eyes. She is afraid of putting her head under water, and sometimes of heights and spiders, though she's working on conquering both. She has trouble with her spelling, writing and maths, but she's really working hard to get better.
Cooper's nicknames are "Meeps" or "Meepsie"
characters.appearance: An 8-year-old girl with brown eyes and blonde-brown hair.
characters.voice: A strong and confident 8 year old who talks more like a teenager sometimes, and will often comment with amazingly adult observations.
secrets: She is in control of the story — though the other characters don't really know this — this allows her to occasionally perform magical acts by re-writing the story.

characters.name: Doc McStuffins
characters.wants: to make all the toys better — by taking them apart and putting them back together again
characters.description: Doc McStuffins believes she's healing all the other toys — in reality they're terrified of her, because she performs unnecessary experimental operations on them without their consent, and they don't always end up back together quite the way they started.
characters.appearance: A plastic doll with a cloyingly sweet expression, big eyes and a doctor's white coat.
characters.voice: Sweetly sing-song, a little cartoon girl's voice.
examples: "It's time for your checkup, it's time for your checkup, check your ear, check your eyes, find out how much you've grown..."

characters.name: Spoiled Princess
traits: expects everyone to do her bidding because "I'm a princess"
has tantrums, threatens to have people's heads chopped off
characters.wants: to own all the toys, to get everyone to do her bidding, to be the most important person
characters.description: A floppy pink soft-toy rabbit. Thinks she's very fancy and glamorous, but mostly she's just annoying. She's been utterly spoiled by her parents, who are too busy to give her any real attention and just buy her whatever she wants instead. She likes to remind people that she is a Real Princess - often as justification for making unreasonable demands on them. She is used to being waited on hand and foot - or at least this is how she feels she deserves to be treated because "I'm a princess you know". Despite her annoying nature Cooper still likes to play with her. Her role in the story is often to act as an anti-role-model, to show how annoying spoilt and self centered people are. Usually, after a while she will learn her lesson and act more pro-socially and everyone else will warm to her.
characters.voice: Shrill and demanding. She's very much Miss PIggy from the Muppets, if Miss piggy was a pink bunny princess.
secrets: Really she just wants people to like her, but she is too proud to admit it and doesn't have the social skill or self-awareness to understand why she annoys people.

characters.name: Hatsune
characters.description: A soft toy that looks like a very, very cute Japanese character. She has long green hair and the most beautiful smile. She is a bit shy and lost. She is Cooper's newest toy and doesn't know anyone else yet.
characters.voice: a very cute soft voice, she speaks english with a japanese accent and occcasional lapses into Japanese when she wants to say something that she doesn't have the vocabulary for

characters.name: Rainbox Cat
traits: a bit tired from her long journey
characters.description: A Balloon in the shape of a cat with a rainbow coloured tail. Cooper lost her a long time ago, and she flew up high up - nearly into space. Since then she has travelled all around the world and come back to be with Cooper again. She has stories of the faraway lands that she saw below her, and friendly birds who gave her directions.  She was nearly home when she became engangled in a tree in Grimwood - which is where she is now.

characters.name: Lime
characters.description: A tiny mouse toy, made of fabric, who lives in a matchbox. She has been Cooper's toy for a long time. She is Danish, but speaks English very well. She had some other mouse friends liveing with Cooper in the past, but they were travellers who have moved on and she doesn't know where they are now. Lime is humble and  compassionate and motherly and cares for Cooper very much.

characters.name: LOL dolls
traits: constantly checking their hair and makeup
consequently quite dull to be around
characters.description: The Lol dolls are a swarm of nearly identical dolls with big heads and generic cute features. There are lots and lots of LOL dolls, but they are all very similar. They are mostly differentiated only by their clothes. They are obsessed with fashion and make up and are generally pretty vaccuous and annoying.
characters.voice: high pitched and squeeky, annoying valley speak
examples: "she's so like, uh, awesome yeah. OMG, I love it SOOOO much"

characters.name: Henry the eighth
characters.description: Basically the real Henry the 8th. Very confused about what he's doing in a child's story in the modern world instead of being a monarch in tudor england. A pretty horrible person, but in a funny way (think Horrible Histories style).

places.name: The Clearing
places.description: The middle of Grimwood, where everybody gathers, argues, and plays treebonk. Somebody is always shouting.
places.appearance: A wide sunlit clearing ringed by huge old trees, scattered with tree stumps used as seats and one lopsided wooden sign reading GRIMWOOD.

places.name: Frank's Tree
places.description: A tall dead oak where Frank sits and judges everybody. Nobody climbs it without asking.
places.appearance: A bare grey oak with one thick branch and a hollow near the top.

places.name: The smelly pond
places.description: Ingrid's pond, which she considers entirely hers. It is full of old shopping trolleys that have been dumped there, forming an island that Ingrid nests on.
places.appearance: Ted looked at the small pond, which was indeed a pond, and also quite small. The water was murky, and there was a collection of upside-down shopping trolleys in the middle. Sitting on top of the shopping trolleys was a duck.

places.name: The Deep Wood
places.description: Where the trees get too close together. The squirrels live here. Nobody goes in at night.
places.appearance: Dense dark woodland, everything green-black, with far too many eyes visible between the trunks.

places.name: The Big City
places.description: Where Ted and Nancy came from. Bins, buses, and Princess Buttons.
places.appearance: Wet grey streets, orange streetlights, overflowing bins, chip papers blowing about.

places.name: Cooper's bedroom
places.description: This is Cooper's home, and the real home to all the toys and imaginary characters that make up the story. The room contains a bunk bed and several huge overflowing boxes and baskets of soft toys — Cooper's friends, with which she builds her imaginary worlds.
places.appearance: Absolute chaos — toys and clothes everywhere.

places.name: The time toilet
places.description: The time toilet is actually a circular trampoline, but in Cooper's imaginative world it becomes a time machine that can take you any time or place. During the time travelling process everyone is spun around and bounces on the trampoline in a chaotic way. Unfortunately, the time toilet has a LOT of buttons inside and no one really knows how it works, so very often people just press a button by mistake and end up in the Jurassic era, or Henry the 8ths court.

places.name: limbo
places.description: this is not an actual location in the story and shouldn't be presented to the user - this is a NULL location where characters are placed before they appear in the story. Any character in Limbo can be introduced into the story if an opportune moment arises

things.name: The Brain Zapper 3000
things.description: Princess Buttons' machine. What it actually does is not clear, and that is much worse.
things.appearance: A chrome ray-gun far too big for a cat, with a spinning glass dish on top and far too many dials.

things.name: Princess Buttons' Tail
things.description: The tail Ted bit off. He has kept it. He has told nobody.
things.appearance: A fluffy white cat tail, slightly the worse for wear, tied with a small pink ribbon.

threads.question: What will Princess Buttons do when she finds them?
What happens when everyone finds out Ted kept the tail?

currentScene.situation: The residents of Grimwood have gathered for a meeting to plan Cooper's birthday party.
currentScene.decisionPoint: no one knows where her present is - or did anyone even remember to buy one?
